scripts.compact: node ../../../tooling/scripts/ensure-compact-package-aliases.mjs && node ../../../tooling/scripts/ensure-compact-artifacts.mjs --manifest src/managed/.compact-artifact.json --source-root src --output src/managed/revocation-registry --recipe-input scripts/strip-managed-sourcemaps.mjs -- sh -c "compact compile src/revocation-registry.compact src/managed/revocation-registry && node ./scripts/strip-managed-sourcemaps.mjs"
scripts.pretest: pnpm run prepare:credentials && pnpm run compact
scripts.pretest:ci: pnpm run prepare:credentials && pnpm run compact
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && rm -rf coverage && rm -rf reports && rm -rf src/managed
scripts.build: pnpm run prepare:credentials && pnpm run compact && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && tsc -b tsconfig.build.json --force && cp -Rf ./src/managed ./dist/ && rm -f ./dist/managed/.compact-artifact.json && cp ./src/revocation-registry.compact ./dist && cp ./src/status-proof-protocol.compact ./dist
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run prepare:credentials && pnpm run compact && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.all: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:ci
